text: The milk sets slowly, mainly by acid, so the curd is fragile and drains on its own in tall moulds. As it ripens from the rind inwards, a creamy rim forms around a fine, slightly grainy heart, with a light mushroom smell.

steps.note: The curd is moulded in tall moulds of 110–115 mm or 85–90 mm, for cheeses of 450–700 g or 250–380 g, and drains on its own at a pH of 4.75 or less.
The cheese is ripened from its rind inwards, with at least 8 of the 14 days held at 8–14 °C.
